Overview

Calama is a city in AN with a population of 180,000. The heart of Chile’s copper mining industry, a high-desert city near the world’s largest open-pit copper mine. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 310 sunny days a year.
